trait_description.value:
(evocation, light, primal)

A creature that takes damage from a lurker in light's mote of light must attempt a DC 22 Will save.

Success: The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to lurker's glow for 24 hours.
Failure: The creature is lined in golden light for 1 minute and can't be concealed during this time. If the creature becomes invisible, it is concealed rather than being undetected.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the creature sheds bright light in a 20-foot emanation for the duration of the effect. In addition, the creature is dazzled on its first turn after failing this save.
A lurker in light's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

action_description.value:
(agile, magical, range increment 10 feet) 2d4+2 force plus lurker's glow
Effects: lurker's glow

(conjuration, primal)

The lurker in light casts summon fey with only a verbal component, using the act of slaughter to replace the normal material and somatic components for the spell. If the fey creature summoned has the same alignment as the lurker in light, the lurker in light can sustain the summon fey spell for up to 1 hour instead of 1 minute.

Trigger: The lurker in light uses a move action

The lurker in light becomes invisible until it enters an area of dim light or darkness, or until it uses a hostile action.

description.value:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success: The target is unaffected.
Success: The target is blinded until its next turn begins.
Failure: The target is blinded for 1 minute.
Critical Failure: The target is blinded permanently.

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting.

The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (3th): The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th): The range increases to 120 feet.

description.value:
You create an orb of light that sheds 3 in a 20-foot radius (and 3 for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (4th): The orb sheds 3 in a 60-foot radius (and 3 for the next 60 feet).

targets.value: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less

description.value: You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (3th): You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th): The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th): The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

description.value:
You shoot a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target is a fiend or undead, you deal an extra 5d6 good damage.

Critical Success: The target takes double fire damage, as well as double good damage if a fiend or undead.
Success: The target takes full damage If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, searing light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+1): The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the good damage against fiends and undead increases by 2d6.

description.value: You conjure a fey to fight for you. This works like summon animal, except you summon a common creature that has the fey trait and whose level is -1.

description.value: Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (5th): The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.
